title: Savoy Children Claim Record With 11 Living Grandparents / In Memory of Mrs. Lucy Durre
text:
ELEVEN LIVING GRANDPARENTS—When Jackie and Jean Moore, shown sitting in their parents' laps, call for "grandfather" or "grandmother," they never know who or how many will answer. They are shown here with their 11 living grandparents, 10 of whom reside in Savoy. They are shown with (front row) Mrs. C. H. Moore, paternal grandmother; J. C. Moore, father; Mrs. J. C. Moore; Jean Moore; Evert Burris; maternal grandmother; (middle row) Mrs. Joe Burris, great-grandmother; Mrs. Mollye Burt, great-grandmother; Mrs. John Moore, great-grandmother; Mrs. E. T. Lawrence, great-grandmother; E. T. Lawrence, great-grandfather; (back row) Evert Burris, grandfather; C. H. Moore, grandfather; Joe Burris, great-grandfather; and John Moore, great-grandfather.

Savoy Children Claim Record
With 11 Living Grandparents

By ELIZABETH LARGE

SAVOY.—Jackie and Jean Moore, son and daughter of Mr. and Mrs. J. C. Moore, believe they have more grandparents than any other children in this area. They top the list with five grandfathers and six grandmothers, with a total of 11 in Savoy.

Jackie will be four years old and Jean will have her second birthday July 15. Recently they had them all together for the first time in the home of Mr. and Mrs. E. T. Lawrence, great-grandparents.

Their mother is the former Miss Mildred Burris, daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Evert Burris of Savoy. Before her marriage to J. C. Moore on Dec. 27, 1914, in Randolph. She was born in Huntsville, Tenn. Her mother, Mrs. Mollye Burt of Randolph, who was Miss Mollye Price before her marriage to W. M. Burt on Oct. 15, 1891, in Tennessee. She was born in Hillboro, Tenn. on July 22, 1865, and moved to Randolph 45 years ago. Mr. Burris is the son of Mr. and

Mrs. Joe Burris of Savoy. He was born in Hidalgo, Ky., and has a twin brother, Aaron, of Savoy.

Mr. and Mrs. Joe Burris are the oldest of the group and have been married a few months longer than any of the other couples. Mr. Burris was born on Oct. 15, 1870, in Gray Creek, Ky. He was a railroad employee for 22 years, then retired and engaged in farming several years before moving to Savoy 11 years ago.

Mrs. Joe Burris was Miss Florence B. Murphy before her marriage to Mr. Burris on Nov. 17, 1891, in Hidalgo, Ky. She was born July 10, 1873, in Humble, Ky.

The children's father, J. C. Moore, is the oldest son of Mr. and Mrs. C. H. Moore. He is employed as storekeeper at Perrin Field. He came to Savoy 21 years ago with his parents. His mother is the former Lula Williams. C. H. Moore was married to Mr. Moore on Nov. 23, 1920, in Bells. Mrs. Moore's mother, Mrs. E. T. Lawrence, was Miss Lula Williams before her marriage to Mr. Lawrence on March 3, 1895, at Tom Bean. She was born June 6, 1875, in Farmington, Tenn. Mr. Lawrence

was born May 4, 1874, in Okaloosa, Ky. He is a retired farmer. The couple moved to Savoy one year ago.

C. H. Moore is the son of Mr. and Mrs. John A. Moore of Savoy. He was born in Bells. He is employed as a barber in Bells. Like Mr. Burris, he also has a twin brother, Clarence, of Denison. His mother was Miss Jessye Kate Mathews before her marriage to Mr. Moore on Dec. 31, 1893, in Bells. She was born March 15, 1874, in Lynnville, Tenn.

Mr. Moore was born May 18, 1873, in Culleoka, Tenn. He was engaged in stock raising before selling his farm north of Bells and moving to Savoy.

In Memory of
Mrs. Lucy Durre

Born July 24, 1877
Died August 22, 1957

Officiating Ministers
Rev. Clifford Longino
Rev. W. A. Rudd

Interment, Sunnyside Cemetery
August 23, 1957
